footer.copy: Decision support for people who prefer context to certainty.

home.lede: IranCoin Premium brings research, signals, and execution context into one calm workspace for disciplined operators.
home.moreMatters: Most platforms show you more. We help you see what matters.
home.moreMattersBody: Markets move quickly. Your decision-making should not have to. We separate observation from interpretation, and interpretation from action—so risk, fees, permissions, and uncertainty stay in frame.
home.ritualBody: Three layers keep the product useful when the market is loud: observable context, explainable interpretation, and bounded execution.
home.observeBody: A quieter market layer: price, liquidity, macro context, and the source behind each signal.
home.interpretBody: Specialized agents surface scenarios and contradictions instead of manufacturing certainty.
home.actBody: You decide. The workspace keeps permissions, execution state, and exposure visible.
home.oneSurfaceBody: A considered view of exposure, connection health, and the reasoning behind a market signal. No black boxes hidden behind a green number.
home.secrets: Secrets never shown in plain text
home.boundaryBody: IranCoin Premium is a technology and information experience. Signals are illustrative, models can be wrong, and financial decisions remain yours. Product availability, instruments, and execution capabilities vary by jurisdiction and platform.
home.calmerBody: Explore the research layer, or open a workspace preview with illustrative data.
home.demoSoon: Account connection is disabled in demo.
home.demoSoonDesc: Live exchange/broker connection requires secure backend and authentication.
